Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) at IE University

What IE University asks of applicants to Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

Spain · All IE University courses · Law field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 4 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • Optional alternative to the required IE University Admissions Test: SAT 1300 or above, or ACT 28 or above

SAT/ACT replace the IE Admissions Test; they are not required in addition. The 2027–2028 Admissions Policy calls these 'recommended minimum scores'.

Verified21 Oct 2026IE University: Freshmen entry requirements
English language
  • All programs taught in English
  • TOEFL iBT 100 (105 recommended; 5.0 on the new 1–6 scale)
  • IELTS 7 (7.5 recommended)
  • Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency
  • Duolingo English Test 130
  • Exempt if living >2 years in an English-speaking country or educated in an English-medium system (e.g. American High School, IB in English, A-levels) for the whole education or the last two years

Certificates valid two years; the Admissions Committee may request a certificate from any candidate.

Verified21 Oct 2026IE University: Freshmen entry requirements
Admissions tests
  • IE University Admissions Test — required unless SAT (1300+), ACT (28+) or LNAT (22+) submitted

The IE Admissions Test may be replaced by SAT/ACT (or LNAT for Law). Results are not shared with the applicant; no pass mark is published.

Verified21 Oct 2026IE University: Freshmen entry requirements

A-Level requirements
Grades

Details
University-wide guideline (does not guarantee admission; not a course requirement): Minimum of three A-Levels; no grade requirement published (applications range AAB to A*A*A*); retakes not accepted

No grade minimum or typical offer is published; AAB–A*A*A* is the range of applications, not a requirement. Spanish legal access also needs five GCSE/IGCSE passes at A–C (4–9). Holistic scoring-system admission.

Partly verified21 Oct 2026IE University: Freshmen entry requirements
IB requirements
Overall score
Not recorded
Details
University-wide guideline (does not guarantee admission; not a course requirement): Full IB Diploma; no minimum points published (typical admissions 34–45, average 36); first results only

34–45 and 36 describe admitted students, not a minimum; no overallScore recorded. Full IB Diploma required (Certificate not legally accepted in Spain); UNED university-access accreditation.

Partly verified21 Oct 2026IE University: Freshmen entry requirements
Other qualifications
  • University-wide guideline (does not guarantee admission; not a course requirement): US High School Diploma: unweighted GPA of at least 3.4 (last three years); AP courses not required but highly recommended; no AP score minimum published
  • Singapore-Cambridge A-Level and HKDSE: not listed (contact Admissions)

Spanish homologation for the US diploma requires official transcripts for Grades 10–12. Singapore A-Level and HKDSE are not mentioned on IE's requirements page.

Partly verified21 Oct 2026IE University: Freshmen entry requirements
Other requirements
  • Holistic, scoring-system review (academic record, extracurriculars, personal background, English, admission test, online assessment); no single factor decisive
  • Online Assessment (written and video responses) for all applicants
  • Personal interview (online) at the Committee's discretion — most candidates expected to complete one
  • CV, one recommendation letter, 'Express Yourself' piece (essay, video or other format)
  • Rolling Admissions Rounds (Early, 1, 2, 3, then post-rounds) with limited program capacity
